WITH income_by_member AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_member,
    SUM(amount) as member_total
  FROM income
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_total) as grand_total FROM income_by_member
),
member_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    member_total,
    member_total / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_sum) as member_share
  FROM income_by_member
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(member_share) as avg_share
  FROM member_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(member_total) as combined_amount,
  AVG(member_share) as average_share,
  AVG(member_share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_calc)) as average_above_average
FROM member_shares
WHERE member_share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_calc)
